data.description: Any creature that begins its turn within 5 feet of a jinmenju must succeed at a DC %1 Will save or be magically compelled to immediately grab a head- fruit and eat it. This is a mind-affecting compulsion effect. A creature that successfully saves is immune to that jinmenju's enticing head-fruits for 24 hours. Anyone who takes a bite out of one suffers from the following effect. [Head-Fruit Poison] Head-fruit-ingested; save Fort DC %1; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d3 Wisdom damage and confused for 1 round; cure 2 consecutive saves.
data.name: Enticing Head-Fruits
